## Delivered

- Migration016_comments.sql: comments/comment_revisions/comment_evidence, forced RLS before reads, no direct client writes, immutable history and real task/deliverable evidence FKs. Session-derived author/name/time; comment expected-version and existing exact idempotency/audit/outbox transactions. Parent locks coordinate mutations and evidence capture; comments do not overwrite parent work content/version.
- add_comment/revise_comment/read_comments/read_comment_history/mention_candidates/can_read_comment, generated33tables/392columns/45public functions. Per-query/detail access independent of summaries and directory. Core participants can discuss task/deliverable records; active scoped managers follow current detail access. Guests retain explicitly shared read-only history; no guest edit interface is invented.
- Author-only drafts, publication without exposing earlier private draft bodies/reasons, own draft tombstone removal, author amendments, reasoned published redaction by author/work owner. Redaction withholds all old bodies from ordinary reads while protected immutable originals and references remain. No purge/retention policy is invented.
- Exact `comment:UUID:revision` evidence tokens are validated by existing immutable task/deliverable snapshot triggers and pinned through composite FKs. Cross-work/draft/missing/removed/redacted references fail closed; evidence edits never rewrite originals. Thread displays original revision and later amendments. P11_A3 uses a trusted synthetic historical decision-bearing deliverable revision, not a newly fabricated governed decision command. Actual task transition RPC pinning is browser-verified. No task/comment operation grants FIN/MCD/deliverable acceptance.
- Shared src/features/comments API/component integrated into existing TaskDetail/DeliverablePage/gateway/router. Plain text only, author/timestamps/version/current permissions, draft/publish/remove/amend/redact/history,20-row paging, bounded eligible participant search. Stale text/base version retained; uncertain writes freeze and retry identical key/payload. Saving another comment preserves unsaved new text. No browser draft storage; explicit navigation/editor closure can discard local text.
- Mentions require active same-term owner/collaborator/deployed explicit member or committee participants. No private directory fallback. Eligibility repeats server-side at write time. Deduplicated comment_mentions outbox events carry opaque IDs/revision only; recipients stay in protected revision metadata. No worker or external message. A future worker must recheck current sender/recipient/work/revision/redaction access.
- docs/comments.md owns signatures, scope, limits and path mapping. Existing common preview host is reused by preview-p11.cjs; no production fixture endpoint or dependency added.
